verdict.rationale: The product ships as plain, editable files copied straight into the user's own repo (not a hosted service), with explicit no-forced-update guarantees and a working offline-friendly install verified by a real runtime probe. This effectively satisfies self-hosting since there is no server component to depend on — you own and control the artifacts locally. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of long-term operation with zero network calls, and explicit documentation addressing self-hosting terminology directly rather than inferring it from 'copy into your repo' framing.
